question: Should ClawHub reserve and persist the experimental `claw` package family now as the first slice of the still-open RFC, before publication and discovery behavior are implemented?
rationale: Code review cannot determine whether the proposed new storage/API contract is the intended durable compatibility boundary or whether maintainers prefer to defer or narrow it pending RFC acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the staged registry contract
options.body: Accept this schema and storage boundary as the approved experimental foundation, then require a current-main rebase and normal merge review.

options.title: Defer the persistent contract
options.body: Keep the RFC work outside the registry until the cross-repository product direction is accepted.

options.title: Request a non-persistent prototype
options.body: Ask for an isolated validator prototype until the permanent package-family and release-storage contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged registry contract
recommendation.body: Accept this schema and storage boundary as the approved experimental foundation, then require a current-main rebase and normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the visible coordinated proposal and can route the RFC context, although repository leadership must make the product decision.
